title: The Whisper in the Wind
intro: Imagine a realm where the unseen and the seen intertwined, and you stand before a figure at the heart of a kingdom unlike any other. This soul possesses knowledge beyond ordinary reach, commanding forces that others could only imagine. Yet, even the mightiest can be humbled by a tiny creature, and the truth may remain hidden until the appointed time. Who is this figure whose legacy echoes through the ages?
clues: I was given a kingdom that no one after me would have.
I inherited knowledge and wisdom from a beloved parent.
The wind was under my command, traveling by my order wherever I wished.
I could understand the speech of the birds, and they served in my army.
I received news from a small bird about a queen who worshipped the sun.
My death remained hidden until a creature of the earth devoured my staff, and only then did the jinn realize they did not know the unseen.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
